entity_raw.definition_raw: Demon SubdomainSource Advanced Player's Guide pg. 1Associated Domain(s): Chaos, EvilAssociated Deities: Abraxas, Aldinach, Andirifkhu, Angazhan, Apep, Areshkagal, Baphomet, Camazotz, Cyth-V'sug, Daclau-Sar, Dagon, Dahak, Deskari, Dretha, Flauros, Ghlaunder, Gogunta, Gyronna, Haagenti, Haggakal, Izyagna, Jezelda, Jubilex, Kabriri, Kitumu, Kostchtchie, Kro'akoth, Lady Nanbyo, Lamashtu, Lanishra, Mazmezz, Menxyr, Mestama, Murnath, Nightripper, Nocticula, Nulgreth, Nurgal, Orcus, Ovonovo, Pazuzu, Rovagug, Rull, Sezelrian, Shamira, Shax, Shivaska, Sifkesh, Sithhud, Socothbenoth, Thamir Gixx, Thremyr, Treerazor, Urazra, Urxehl, Varg, Xoveron, Ydersius, Yhidothrus, Zagresh, Zevgavizeb, Zogmugot, ZuraReplacement Power: The following granted power replaces the touch of chaos power of the Chaos domain or the touch of evil power of the Evil domain. Demons are a race of chaotic evil outsiders. Fury of the Abyss (Su): As a swift action, you can give yourself an enhancement bonus equal to 1/2 your cleric level (minimum +1) on melee attacks, melee damage rolls, and combat maneuver checks. This bonus lasts for 1 round. During this round, you take a –2 penalty to AC. You can use this ability for a number of times per day equal to 3 + your Wisdom modifier.Replacement Domain Spells: 1st—doom, 3rd—rage, 6th—planar binding (demons only).
